claim: Try it with sample data shows three useful records immediately, and the editable app sample project stays separate from real records.
where: landing hero, demo banner, desktop first-run screen, README
sandbox: fresh 390px browser context; click the landing action and assert a sample row is in the next viewport, then edit/reset the app sample project and assert only demo-prefixed storage changes

claim: Receipt OCR runs on your computer; images are not uploaded or retained after recognition.
sandbox: isolated app demo; run bundled OCR on the shipped receipt, assert no external runtime request, and assert no image data enters storage

claim: The free app includes search and CSV export.
sandbox: fresh browser context; add a typed sample receipt, search the saved inventory, and assert a CSV download

claim: Pay $29 once for unlimited receipt intake and JSON backup.
sandbox: fresh browser context; assert the one-time $29 field-kit price and checkout link

claim: Choose an unsigned macOS, Windows, or Linux installer for your computer.
sandbox: mock GitHub Releases API metadata; assert all three OS choices, unsigned notice, detected download, cache, and no redirect fetch

claim: Each receipt line can be reviewed with its own room, category, and warranty date, then searched.
sandbox: fresh app storage; paste the shipped receipt text, review its fields, save it, and search the resulting inventory

where: desktop intake privacy note and inventory
sandbox: isolated app demo; save a mixed-room receipt, edit a saved item's room, category, and warranty, and assert persisted changes

claim: Several receipt images can be queued after a large shop.
sandbox: fresh app storage; select two copies of the shipped receipt image and assert both distinct receipts reach inventory

claim: Receipt intake accepts JPG, PNG, or WebP images up to 10 MB each and provides recovery guidance for rejected files.
sandbox: isolated app demo; provide an unsupported file and a PNG over 10 MB, then assert both are rejected without losing the manual fallback

claim: The app creates printable inventory output and lets you undo a deletion for five seconds.
sandbox: seed one local record; inspect the generated printable document, remove the record, undo, and assert persistence

claim: No account is required; reviewed inventory is stored locally without sending receipt contents to another origin.
sandbox: fresh app storage; complete manual intake while recording requests, then assert the record in localStorage and no external request

claim: The paid field kit downloads and restores validated JSON backups without replacing records from a malformed file.
sandbox: cached valid license and one known-good record; import a syntactically valid malformed backup and assert the record and render remain intact

claim: Payment fragments are redacted from CSV and printable exports.
where: desktop intake note, landing how-it-works, README, privacy page
sandbox: isolated app demo record containing a card number; assert CSV and printable output contain the redaction marker and not the number

claim: The app has no analytics, telemetry, advertising, crash reporter, or third-party runtime scripts; the website sets no analytics cookies.
sandbox: record requests through an app demo export and inspect the privacy page's scripts and browser cookies

claim: License verification is cached for one day and sends only the license token to the Sociobot billing API.
sandbox: recorded verify response; assert checkout token storage, URL stripping, unlock, and no second verification request on reload

claim: License verification allows 30 requests per service window, then returns 429; the app displays a wait of at least one second.
sandbox: recorded throttled verification response with Retry-After zero; assert the client presents a non-zero one-second wait; live gate checks the 30-request allowance

claim: Manual intake, editing, and CSV export work while the desktop app is offline.
sandbox: fresh app storage; load the packaged UI, take the browser context offline, add a typed receipt, and export CSV
